name: James
summary: One of the twelve apostles Jesus chose, called James the son of Alphaeus. Scripture names him in the lists of the twelve and among those praying in the upper room after Jesus was taken up.

key_moments.title: Chosen as One of the Twelve
key_moments.description: After Jesus prayed all night on a mountain, He called His disciples and chose twelve of them, whom He named apostles. James the son of Alphaeus was one of the twelve.

key_moments.title: Sent Out to Preach and Heal
key_moments.description: Jesus gave the twelve power to cast out unclean spirits and to heal every kind of sickness and disease, and sent them out. James the son of Alphaeus is named among them.

key_moments.title: Prays with the Others in the Upper Room
key_moments.description: After Jesus was taken up, the apostles went into an upper room in Jerusalem. James the son of Alphaeus was there, and they all kept on praying together with the women, Mary the mother of Jesus, and His brothers.
